description: Take topics out of the AutoSEO queue so they are never written. Pass up to 50 topic ids from list_content_queue (`queued[].id`). Use it to clear topics the site should not spend articles on, or to make room when queue_article answers `queue_full`. Nothing is written or spent, and queueing the same text again with queue_article brings a topic back. WRITE ACTION: requires a Pro plan or higher.
name: skip_queued_topics
